uncited: *   **Inputs:** A trained neural duplex radiance field consisting of an inner mesh and an outer mesh (extracted from SDFs), per-vertex radiance features computed from input images, associated depth maps, and a target viewing direction $\mathbf{d}$.
**Meshes:** Two triangle meshes (inner and outer) representing the iso-surfaces of the SDF.
This produces the inner and outer meshes.
These features are attached to the vertices of the extracted meshes.
**Rasterization (Feature Buffer Generation):** Use hardware rasterization to render the inner and outer meshes.
**Feature Aggregation:** Send the feature buffers and the per-pixel view direction $\mathbf{d}$ into a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) implemented as GLSL shaders.
*   **Time Complexity:** The rendering time is dominated by hardware rasterization and the CNN aggregation.
